camel_example: aliyun aidge TextTranslateAsync --region cn-hangzhou --TargetLanguage en --SourceTextList '["Hello,world"]' --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Translates text by using the Maas MT model, an e-commerce translation model trained on over 1 billion high-quality bilingual sentence pairs and optimized for e-commerce terms such as brands, models, materials, and attributes. It supports 156 languages, more than 400 language pairs, and automatic language detection for source texts
description_zh: Maas MT是10亿+ 高质量双语句对训练出的电商领域翻译模型，针对电商领域特有的品牌、型号、材质、属性等术语进行不断优化。支持156种语言，累计400多映射关系，并在原始语向上支持自动识别
kebab_example: aliyun aidge text-translate-async --target-language en --source-text-list Hello,world --region cn-hangzhou
name: TextTranslateAsync

parameters.help_en: The source language code. For more information, see the supported language list below. If this parameter is not specified, the language is automatically detected
parameters.help_zh:
源语言代码，见下方支持列表。
不传入该参数则自动检测语种
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. For more information, see the supported language pair list below
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，见如下支持语向列表
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The list of texts to be translated
parameters.name: source_text_list

parameters.help_en: The format type of the source text. Valid values: text and html
parameters.help_zh:
源文本的格式类型；
当前支持 text/html
parameters.name: format_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intervention glossary. You must create the glossary in the console and provide its ID in the request parameters. If the intervention glossary ID is empty, the translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表 ID需要在前台单独创建，并在输入参数中提供其 ID。如果提供的干预词表 ID 为空，则翻译结果将不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario identifier. You can specify only one of the following values. After you specify a value, the translation engine uses the terminology library and style policy of the corresponding industry to output industry-specific translations. If this parameter is not specified or an invalid value is specified, the general translation policy is used. Valid values:
e-commerce-title: Translates cross-border e-commerce product titles.
e-commerce-description: Translates cross-border e-commerce product descriptions.
e-commerce-chat: Translates cross-border e-commerce conversations.
e-commerce-cpv: Translates cross-border e-commerce product CPV attributes.
novel: Translates novels.
game: Translates games
parameters.help_zh:
业务场景标识，仅可传入下方任意一个值，传入后翻译引擎将调用对应行业的术语库与风格策略，输出更贴合行业的译文；未传该字段或者传错的时候会执行通用翻译策略。
可选值为下方英文部分 ：
e-commerce-title ，跨境电商商品标题翻译 ; e-commerce-description ，跨境电商商品详描翻译 ; e-commerce-chat ，跨境电商会话翻译 ; e-commerce-cpv ， 跨境电商商品 CPV 属性翻译 ;  novel ，小说翻译 ; game ，游戏翻译
parameters.name: translate_scene

parameters.help_en: The business name of the caller. This field represents your identity and facilitates subsequent communication. If you are an internal Alibaba organization, specify this parameter based on the actual scenario, such as BU name-product or BU name-chat. If you are an external partner, specify the full name of your company. The company name must be the same as the one used when registering your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 此字段代表您的身份，便于后续各类问题的沟通。如果您是阿里内部组织，建议您根据实际场景进行传入，例如BU名称-商品，或者BU名称 -chat等；如果您是阿里外部伙伴，建议您传入公司名称的全称，此公司名称需要和您注册阿里云账号时候的公司名称保持一致
parameters.name: biz_name

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the caller. The maximum length is 128 characters. This ID is passed through in the translation results
parameters.help_zh: 长度128个字符，翻译结果中会同步透传该ID
parameters.name: biz_id

Code.description_en: The response code of the submission call. Example: success
Code.description_zh: 提交调用响应代码；成功示例为 success
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The submission result of the text translation asynchronous node
Data.description_zh: 文本翻译异步任务提交结果

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task. It is used for result queries and notification association. Do not use the example prefix as a business validation rule
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务标识，用于结果查询和通知关联；不以示例前缀作为业务校验规则
TaskId.title_en: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID
TaskId.title_zh: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID

Data.title_en: 文本翻译异步任务提交结果
Data.title_zh: 文本翻译异步任务提交结果

Message.description_en: The invocation message. Example of a successful call: Success. If the call fails, check the actual error message
Message.description_zh: 调用说明；成功示例为 Success，失败时读取实际错误信息
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the submission request. It is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次提交请求 ID，用于排查

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the submission call is successful. A successful call does not mean that the translation is complete
Success.description_zh: 提交调用是否成功，不代表翻译已完成
